description: DTC Brands Are Targeting Grandparents 👵🏼 Let me know what you think 🤔
transcript: D T C brands are suddenly targeting grandparents, and this is a much bigger strategy than it sounds. For years, brands have built everything around Gen Z. Fast edits, trendy creators, meme driven ads, TikTok shop being on the rise. But brands like Little Spoon and Bodi Air are realizing the person using the product is not always the person paying for it. Grandparents and boomer parents are often buying for their entire family, and Little Spoon can target grandparents who want healthier food at their house when the grandkids visit. It can also position the product as a way to help busy parents without buying another toy. Fortier can target older consumers buying gifts for birthdays, holidays, new homes, client events, and family gatherings. That gives the brand more occasions to sell and a customer with significantly more purchasing power to buy. The creative changes too. Less intent, humor, more family moments, convenience, gifting, trust, and quality. This is called expanding the buyer, not just the audience. Instead of fighting every brand for the same young customer, they're targeting the person actually funding the household. The smartest EDC brands are not asking who uses our product. They're asking who else has a reason to buy it. Let me know what you think.
